source: Ed4 C.6.5 and C.6.6, pp.C-71 to C-73; C.7.6.3, pp.C-120 to C-122; corpus-format.md 6.2 step 6
description: The MAX-SPEED probe moves to the next position of the bulk walk, skipping a ladder rung that is only on the latency walk.
note: Table (corpus-format.md 6.1) as drc-rx-trial-after-clean-run with probe_run 3, bulk_rungs [0, 1, 3] and latency_rungs [0, 2, 3]: WN 6 Long (position 2) is on the ladder for latency only. Flow as drc-rx-capability-records-ed4: conn 1 binds SAP 5; at 1000 to 3000 a burst holding a PADDING from 0.0.1.3 to us with CAPABILITY (Ed4 1), EOT 10, records 0.0.1.3 Ed4 (C-1261); the request at 1500 queues "hello" for 0.0.1.3; at 52000 one transmission (WN 2 Long, block 256 bytes) holds the type 7 and 20 PADDING D_PDUs, all to 0.0.1.3, whose 21 EOWs are the top priority of Table C-25 (MAX-SPEED, LOW-SPEED), then SENDER-APPROACH 0xB04, then the rotation MAX-SPEED, LOW-SPEED, MAX-SEGMENT 0xAFF from its start (interp C-1260, C-1286). Earlier bursts (burst_started, bytes_received 30 ms later and, for a second block, 40 ms later, burst_ended 60 ms later) hold a PADDING with EOT 0 (C-0105), or a type 7 to us whose data CRC fails (a D_PDU error, C-0836), or a block of 16 bytes with no sync that are not all zero. Codes: MAX-SPEED 0x8A0 + WN and LOW-SPEED 0x9A0 + WN at Long (C-0462, C-0469). Table positions: WN 2, 4, 6, 7 Long are 0 to 3; thresholds on WN 2 Long bulk -100, 50, 150, 300 and latency -100, 100, 200, 400; on WN 4 Long bulk -100, 0, 100, 150 and latency -100, 100, 300, 400; on WN 6 Long bulk -100, 0, 300, 500 and latency -100, 200, 400, 600; on WN 7 Long bulk -100, -50, 100, 400 and latency -100, 0, 300, 600; smoothing weight 8, clean run 2, error limit 500 ppt, caps 2 doubling to 8. Since corpus 0.36.0 (P7-9 round 3) a move up by the estimate goes straight to its target after the clean run, not one rung (interp C-1270), each recommendation walks only the ladder positions bulk_rungs or latency_rungs give (all when null), and a burst with a lost block is not clean (corpus-format.md 6.2). At 100 a clean burst on WN 4 Long, estimate 50: S = 50; on the bulk walk the target is 1 (0; 150 at position 3 is above), on the latency walk 0 (300 at position 2 is above); the first recommendation is the target, not above WN 4 Long's position 1: MAX-SPEED WN 4 Long, LOW-SPEED WN 2 Long. At 200 the same; WN 4 Long's clean run is 2, the targets equal the recommendations, and 2 is short of probe_run 3. The CAPABILITY burst, clean, on WN 4 Long, estimate 50: the clean run is 3, the bulk target (1) is not above MAX-SPEED (1), so the probe moves MAX-SPEED to the next position of the bulk walk, 3, WN 7 Long (interp C-1291 as revised in corpus 0.36.0; with every position on the walk it went to WN 6 Long, drc-rx-probe-after-clean-run). LOW-SPEED holds at WN 2 Long. EOWs: 0x8A7, 0x9A2, 0xB04, then 0x8A7, 0x9A2, 0xAFF repeated, 21 in all.
